description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 08.10.2018 to 14.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and rescinds a previous notification, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning the administration of customs laws and procedures.
